name: 03_forestry_seasoning
description: DESIGN 4.x / 5.1: store, felling, limbing & bucking, splitting, drying rack, tarp, 60-day cure, ground rot to punk wood.

steps.log: Forestry: buy gear, fell a birch, limb & buck it, split a round, rack the green wood, tarp it, season 60 days, watch a ground log rot

steps.exec: phone.credits.credits += 600  # staged: credits earned from earlier fires

steps.message: phone opens on the home screen
Enter opens the Store
bought a waterproof tarp
bought the drop-forged felling axe

steps.assert: world.target is not None and world.target['kind'] == 'tree'
steps.message: aiming at a standing birch
face notch and back-cut chopped
the birch falls (rigid-body pivot about the hinge)

steps.exec: scratch['ft'] = next(f for f in world.fallen_trees if f.tree_id == scratch['tree'].id)

steps.assert: len(world.world_items) == scratch['n_items'] and scratch['ft'].limbs_left > 3 and scratch['ft'].rounds_left > 5
steps.message: the whole birch lies on the ground, crown and all, waiting to be limbed and bucked

steps.exec: scratch['limb'] = min((l for l in scratch['ft'].limbs if not l.removed), key=lambda l: l.s); scratch['la'] = scratch['ft'].point_at(scratch['limb'].s, terrain.height); player.position[0], player.position[2] = (scratch['la'] - scratch['ft'].dir * 1.1 + scratch['ft'].side * 0.5)[[0, 2]]; player.snap_to_ground(); player.look_at(scratch['la'] + scratch['ft'].limb_direction(scratch['limb']) * 0.25)  # staged: walk up the trunk

steps.assert: world.target is not None and world.target['kind'] == 'fallen_limb'
steps.message: crosshair on a limb of the felled birch

steps.assert: scratch['limb'].removed and any(w.kind in ('kindling_pile', 'tinder_source') for w in world.world_items[scratch['n_items']:])
steps.message: the limb comes off as green kindling and a tinder bundle of twigs & bark

steps.exec: scratch['cp'] = scratch['ft'].point_at(0.3, terrain.height); player.position[0], player.position[2] = (scratch['cp'] + scratch['ft'].side * 1.05)[[0, 2]]; player.snap_to_ground(); player.look_at(scratch['cp'])  # staged: walk back to the butt

steps.assert: world.target is not None and world.target['kind'] == 'fallen_trunk'
steps.message: crosshair on the felled trunk
the first round comes free once its kerf is cut through

steps.exec: scratch['log'] = [w for w in world.world_items if w.kind == 'fuel' and w.fuel and w.fuel.kind == 'log' and 'round' in w.label][-1]

steps.message: freshly felled wood is green (core > 90 % moisture)

steps.assert: world.target is not None and world.target['obj'] is scratch['log']
steps.message: aiming at the freed round

steps.assert: scratch['log'] not in world.world_items and sum(1 for w in world.world_items if w.label.startswith('Split')) >= 2
steps.message: the round splits into firewood with the axe
steps.value: sum(1 for w in world.world_items if w.label.startswith('Split'))

steps.message: picked up a green split piece
green firewood stacked on the raised rack
tarp stretched over the rack
T opens the Pass Time menu
selected the 60-day cure period
60 days passed
tarped rack seasoned green wood toward ~12-20 % EMC
the best log cured below 20 % core moisture
a further 90 days turned the season to autumn

steps.assert: any(w.fuel.species.value == 'Punk Wood' for w in world.ground_logs if w.fuel)
steps.message: the green oak left on the soil rotted into punk wood
steps.value: [(w.label, round(w.fuel.moisture, 2)) for w in world.ground_logs if w.fuel][:3]

steps.assert: any(world.inventory.peek(k) is not None and world.inventory.peek(k).moisture < 0.25 for k in ('log', 'firewood'))
steps.message: took a seasoned piece off the rack
